officialJoinRule: NFC, trim whitespace, remove one trailing parenthetical qualifier for base-name comparison, then require exact elevation in metres

reviewPolicy.identity: A summit was accepted only after OSM name/alias, coordinate, elevation, and the KFS location string were reviewed together; name alone was never enough.
reviewPolicy.existingDestination: Same physical summit, current production point <=250 m from reviewed OSM point, and production elevation within 100 m of KFS height.
reviewPolicy.catalogRepair: Same identity only, exact before-to-after move <=750 m, and elevation change <=10 m. No KFS row required this outcome.
reviewPolicy.duplicateGuard: Every production destination and every other KFS reviewed point within 150 m is listed explicitly.
reviewPolicy.officialConflictResolution: Pinned XLSX roster name/elevation governs source identity; current liveName is retained and any conflict is explicit.

officialKfs.role: Official source identity, roster name, elevation, and location qualifier.
officialKfs.rightsNote: Bare roster facts are used for identity. KFS says KOGL-marked works must retain the marked type and attribution; this artifact does not claim an unmarked KFS work is open-licensed.

openStreetMap.role: Summit coordinates, stable node IDs, names/aliases, and supporting elevation tags.

wikidata.role: Supporting evidence only for Hallasan's OSM node linkage and elevation.

production.role: Read-only Peaks production fingerprint and neighbor/identity comparison.

manualOverrides.reason: Name-only candidates are outside the KFS Gyeongju location. 고위봉 has the exact 495.1 m KFS height in Gyeongju Namsan.
The KFS qualifier is 암마이산. OSM 암마이봉 is 687 m; nearby 숫마이산 is the other physical summit.
The lower-delta 의상봉 candidate is near Seoul. The selected 의상봉 is inside KFS Buan/Byeonsan, despite the source elevation conflict.
소속리산 only contains the Korean name string. Songnisan's high point is 천왕봉 at the exact KFS 1058.4 m height and location.
The South Korea natural=peak query returns 한라산동능정상 without an elevation. OSM/Wikidata link the exact 1947 m Hallasan identity to natural=volcano node 8334051398.
The existing/Wikidata-linked 1468.3 m OSM node is the roster-height main summit. Node 5429893547 duplicates that summit about 15 m away; 중봉 node 7972716230 is a distinct 1446.1 m top.
